decision: Within the specified original planned P03 A stimulus/recovery, controlled own-window restore/show may be tested under existing scope; no explicit must-human-restore requirement found. This does not authorize recovering from unexpected focus loss or an already-yielded guard.

originalContract.steps: 隐藏/最小化文件和终端区域，捕获resizeRPC。
originalContract.expected: 不发送0×0；再次显示按真实尺寸fit；不重建PTY。

rules.meaning: Real packaged App A and real input/business boundaries; system/human requirements apply where the case requires them, not a universal manual restore gate.

rules.quote: 运行中失焦仍停止，不再次激活或重新武装。
rules.interpretation: Binding rule for unexpected loss/yield recovery. The original planned minimize/restore sequence may not be used after such loss to activate/refocus or rearm.

rules.quote: 不得主动抢焦点、伪造手势或重置已yield的守卫
rules.interpretation: No extra w.focus, Page.bringToFront, repeated activation or yielded-guard reset. A planned own-window show/restore stimulus is not permission for additional focus recovery.

rules.quote: 仍复用原sticky guard，中途失焦不自动重置或抢回。
rules.interpretation: Keep sticky failure; if actual focus is not restored naturally following the one planned window action, record/stop rather than compensating.

driverEvidence.historicalFocusCallsAreNotCurrentAuthori: Do not inherit those historical force-focus calls; the current requested restore/show-only boundary is narrower and preserves current guard.

permittedBoundary: Fresh isolated healthy task/own App with exact PID/exe/userData/window identity and unchanged initial activation+3s+single guard.
Before planned minimize, verify no prior yield or unexpected loss; the test stimulus is explicitly recorded before executing it.
One original planned minimize and one restore/show to the same exact own window; no Input events during this known window-state transition.
Never disable/reset/reinstall the guard, focus the window explicitly or reconnect to another instance.
Before any later input or screenshot requiring focus, verify same window/native focused+visible+notminimized and real main DOM focused/visible with original guard still live.
If the guard has yielded or unexpected focus loss occurs elsewhere, stop; if planned restore does not actually recover required real focus, stop without a second restore/activation.
Do not infer user/external cause from foreground name or state transition; record native/DOM sequence and original resizeRPC/samePTY identity.
scope: Original P03 A only, not a new S layer, human hand-feel, permissions, arbitrary App focus recovery or pass before execution.
